name: print-social-word-play-poster-trio-orange-and-blue
title: Three word-play posters in orange, blue and cream with cropped type in boxes
whatItIs: Three portrait posters on black. One is orange with 'LOOK OUT THE WINDOW' broken into words inside blue boxes that crop the letters; one is white with 'CIRCLE' and an orange disc with stripe cut-outs; one is orange with a big white circle and 'PLATE' set vertically in black.
whatItMeans: Playful and clever; layouts act out the word.
techniques: Place each word in its own coloured box that crops the letters.
Draw the named shape (circle, plate) as the main image.
Rotate a title vertically along the edge.
Tuck small text into gaps as a texture.

vocabulary.definition: Cutting letters at a box edge so they are partly hidden.
Drawing the shape a word describes.
Text rotated to run up the side.
Small blocks of text used as texture.
